```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(anytime)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
```

```{r}
## pull up data files
fy23 <- read.csv("fy23.csv", header=TRUE)
fy24 <- read.csv("fy24.csv", header=TRUE)
fy25 <- read.csv("fy25.csv", header=TRUE)

## combine data files into one "data" dataframe
data <- rbind(fy23, fy24)
data <- rbind(data, fy25)

##convert dates to YYYY-MM-DD format
##select data from 2023-01-01 to 2025-09-30 (24-month timeframe)
data$collection_date <- anydate(data$collection_date)
data <- subset(data, data$collection_date > "2022-12-31" & data$collection_date < "2025-10-01")

##select data from chicken parts project only
data <- subset(data, data$project_code == "HC_CPT_LBW01")

## exclude samples with no data result
data <- subset(data, data$salmonella_sp_analysis!="NULL")

## exclude product_type==NULL
data <- subset(data, data$product_type!="NULL")

## exclude samples from pilot plant establishments
data <- subset(data, data$establishment_number!="P20604+V20604")
data <- subset(data, data$establishment_number!="P1201")
data <- subset(data, data$establishment_number!="P1304B+V1304B")
data <- subset(data, data$establishment_number!="P1304A+V1304A")

##save all the establishment IDs in a separate vector
establishment_ids <- sort(unique(data$establishment_id))

##pull up MPI directory csv
establishment_size_data<-read.csv("MPI_Directory_by_Establishment_Number.csv", header=TRUE)

##select for establishments that are present in our establishment_ids vector
establishment_size_data<-filter(establishment_size_data, establishment_size_data$establishment_id %in% data$establishment_id)

##grab establishment information
data$establishment_size=NA
data$establishment_zip=NA
data$latitude=NA
data$longitude=NA

for (i in 1:length(establishment_ids)) {
  row = establishment_size_data[which(establishment_size_data$establishment_id==establishment_ids[i], arr.ind=TRUE)[1],]
  data$establishment_size[data$establishment_id==establishment_ids[i]]<-row$size
  data$establishment_zip[data$establishment_id==establishment_ids[i]]<-row$zip
  data$latitude[data$establishment_id==establishment_ids[i]]<-row$latitude
  data$longitude[data$establishment_id==establishment_ids[i]]<-row$longitude
}

#exclude samples without establishment size information
data<-subset(data, !is.na(data$establishment_size))
data<-subset(data, data$establishment_size!="N / A")

##change screening result of Negative samples with an enumeration value to "Positive"
data$salmonella_sp_analysis[data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Negative" & data$salmonella_quantitative_cfu_ml=="<10"]<-"Positive"

data<-select(data, form_id, establishment_id, establishment_number, establishment_name, establishment_size, establishment_state, project_code, collection_date, sample_source_name, product_type, salmonella_sp_analysis, salmonella_quantitative_cfu_ml, establishment_zip, latitude, longitude)

##convert all the "NULL"s to NA (R can intrinsically recognize NA)
data$salmonella_quantitative_cfu_ml[which(data$salmonella_quantitative_cfu_ml == "NULL")] <- NA

write.csv(data, "poultryparts_38968.csv")

##positive samples with no enumeration result dropped from dataset
data <- subset(data, !(salmonella_sp_analysis == "Positive" & is.na(salmonella_quantitative_cfu_ml)))
```

```{r}
##read in serotypes data files
fy23_serotypes <- read.csv("fy23 serotypes.csv", header=TRUE)
fy24_serotypes <- read.csv("fy24 serotypes.csv", header=TRUE)
fy25_serotypes <- read.csv("fy25 serotypes.csv", header=TRUE)

## combine serotype data files into one "serotypes" dataframe
serotypes <- rbind(fy23_serotypes, fy24_serotypes)
serotypes <- rbind(serotypes, fy25_serotypes)

##pull form ids (sample ids)
salmonella_positive_ids <- data %>%
  filter(salmonella_sp_analysis == "Positive") %>%
  pull(form_id)

##subset salmonella data
serotypes_matched <- serotypes %>%
  filter(grepl("SALM", pathogen_number)) %>%
  filter(form_id %in% salmonella_positive_ids)

unique_form_id<-unique(serotypes_matched$form_id)

serotypes_wide <- serotypes_matched %>%
  group_by(form_id) %>%
  mutate(isolate_n = row_number()) %>%
  filter(isolate_n <= 2) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = form_id,
    names_from = isolate_n,
    values_from = salmonella_serotype,
    names_prefix = "salmonella_serotype"
  )

#join to data
data <- data %>%
  mutate(form_id = trimws(as.character(form_id))) %>%
  left_join(
    serotypes_wide %>%
      mutate(form_id = trimws(as.character(form_id))) %>%
      select(form_id, salmonella_serotype1),
    by = "form_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    salmonella_serotype1 = case_when(
      salmonella_sp_analysis == "Positive" & is.na(salmonella_serotype1) ~ "No serotype data available",
      salmonella_sp_analysis == "Positive" & salmonella_serotype1 == "Final result - characterization not available" ~ "No serotype data available",
      salmonella_sp_analysis == "Negative" ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ salmonella_serotype1
    )
  )

write.csv(data, "poultryparts_38682.csv")
```

```{r}
#dataframe - PREVALENCE
fiftytwo_results_prevalence<-data.frame(
  establishment_id=integer(),
  rolling_window=character(), 
  start_date=character(), 
  end_date=character(), 
  n_pos=integer(),
  n_pos_adj=integer(),
  percent_pos=integer(),
  percent_pos_adj=numeric(),
  n_neg=integer(),
  percent_neg=numeric(),
  total_sample_no = integer(),
  n_pos_breast = integer(),
  n_neg_breast = integer(),
  n_pos_leg = integer(),
  n_neg_leg = integer(),
  n_pos_wing = integer(),
  n_neg_wing = integer(),
  rw_category = character(),
  establishment_size=character()
  )
```

```{r}
## PREVALENCE BASED STANDARDS

## SKIP WINDOWS WITH LESS THAN 10 SAMPLES

data<-read.csv("poultryparts_38968.csv", header=TRUE)
data$collection_date <- as.Date(data$collection_date)

##low sample size adjustment
##subtract 1 from number of positives if total sample number is <52
for (j in 1:length(establishment_ids)) {
  
  fiftytwo_start<-as.Date("2023-01-01")
  fiftytwo_end<-fiftytwo_start+days(363)
  fiftytwo_interval<-interval(fiftytwo_start, fiftytwo_end)
  
  for (i in 1:92) {
    
    if (fiftytwo_end > as.Date("2025-09-30")) {
      break }
    
    if (sum(data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval & data$establishment_id==establishment_ids[j]) < 10) {
    
      fiftytwo_start<-fiftytwo_start+days(7)
      fiftytwo_end<-fiftytwo_end+days(7)
      fiftytwo_interval<-interval(fiftytwo_start, fiftytwo_end)
      
      next }
        
        new_results <- data.frame(
          ##specify start and end dates in the table
          rolling_window = as.character(i),
          start_date = as.character(fiftytwo_start),
          end_date = as.character(fiftytwo_end),
          
          ##sum number of PASS, little m, and big M within the proposed interval
          n_pos = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Positive" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval &
                        data$establishment_id==establishment_ids[j]),
          n_neg = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Negative" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval &
                        data$establishment_id==establishment_ids[j]),
          n_pos_breast = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Positive" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval
                                  & data$establishment_id == establishment_ids[j] & data$product_type=="Breast"),
          n_pos_leg = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Positive" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval
                                  & data$establishment_id == establishment_ids[j] & data$product_type=="Leg"),
          n_pos_wing = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Positive" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval
                                  & data$establishment_id == establishment_ids[j] & data$product_type=="Wing"),
          n_neg_breast = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Negative" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval
                                  & data$establishment_id == establishment_ids[j] & data$product_type=="Breast"),
          n_neg_leg = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Negative" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval
                                  & data$establishment_id == establishment_ids[j] & data$product_type=="Leg"),
          n_neg_wing = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Negative" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval
                                  & data$establishment_id == establishment_ids[j] & data$product_type=="Wing"),
          establishment_id = establishment_ids[j],
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ) 
      
      new_results$total_sample_no = sum(new_results$n_pos, new_results$n_neg)
      
      new_results$n_pos_adj = ifelse(new_results$total_sample_no < 52 & new_results$n_pos > 0,
                                     new_results$n_pos - 1, new_results$n_pos)
      new_results$percent_pos = (new_results$n_pos / new_results$total_sample_no) * 100
      new_results$percent_pos_adj = (new_results$n_pos_adj / new_results$total_sample_no) * 100
      new_results$percent_neg = (new_results$n_neg / new_results$total_sample_no) * 100
      new_results$rw_category = ifelse(new_results$percent_pos_adj > 15.4, "3",
                                ifelse(new_results$percent_pos_adj > 7.7 &
                                       new_results$percent_pos_adj <= 15.4, "2",
                                ifelse(new_results$percent_pos_adj <= 7.7, "1", "")))
      
      row = data[which(data$establishment_id==establishment_ids[j], arr.ind=TRUE)[1],]
      new_results$establishment_size=row$establishment_size

      ##combine the new results with the all_results table
      fiftytwo_results_prevalence <- bind_rows(fiftytwo_results_prevalence, new_results)
    
    fiftytwo_start<-fiftytwo_start+days(7)
    fiftytwo_end<-fiftytwo_end+days(7)
    fiftytwo_interval<-interval(fiftytwo_start, fiftytwo_end)
      
    }
}

write.csv(fiftytwo_results_prevalence, "prevalencebasedresults_withoutNAcategory.csv")
```

```{r}
## NO SKIPPING WINDOWS WITH LESS THAN 10 SAMPLES

data<-read.csv("poultryparts_38968.csv", header=TRUE)
data$collection_date <- as.Date(data$collection_date)

## include windows that have less than 10 samples, just categorize as NA

for (j in 1:length(establishment_ids)) {
  
  fiftytwo_start<-as.Date("2023-01-01")
  fiftytwo_end<-fiftytwo_start+days(363)
  fiftytwo_interval<-interval(fiftytwo_start, fiftytwo_end)
  
  for (i in 1:100) {
    
    if (fiftytwo_end > as.Date("2025-09-30")) {
      break }
    
    if (sum(data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval & data$establishment_id==establishment_ids[j]) == 0) {
    
      fiftytwo_start<-fiftytwo_start+days(7)
      fiftytwo_end<-fiftytwo_end+days(7)
      fiftytwo_interval<-interval(fiftytwo_start, fiftytwo_end)
      
      next }
        
        new_results <- data.frame(
          ##specify start and end dates in the table
          rolling_window = as.character(i),
          start_date = as.character(fiftytwo_start),
          end_date = as.character(fiftytwo_end),
          
          ##sum number of PASS, little m, and big M within the proposed interval
          n_pos = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Positive" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval &
                        data$establishment_id==establishment_ids[j]),
          n_neg = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Negative" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval &
                        data$establishment_id==establishment_ids[j]),
          n_pos_breast = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Positive" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval
                                  & data$establishment_id == establishment_ids[j] & data$product_type=="Breast"),
          n_pos_leg = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Positive" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval
                                  & data$establishment_id == establishment_ids[j] & data$product_type=="Leg"),
          n_pos_wing = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Positive" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval
                                  & data$establishment_id == establishment_ids[j] & data$product_type=="Wing"),
          n_neg_breast = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Negative" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval
                                  & data$establishment_id == establishment_ids[j] & data$product_type=="Breast"),
          n_neg_leg = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Negative" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval
                                  & data$establishment_id == establishment_ids[j] & data$product_type=="Leg"),
          n_neg_wing = sum(data$salmonella_sp_analysis=="Negative" & data$collection_date %within% fiftytwo_interval
                                  & data$establishment_id == establishment_ids[j] & data$product_type=="Wing"),
          establishment_id = establishment_ids[j],
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ) 
      
      new_results$total_sample_no = sum(new_results$n_pos, new_results$n_neg)
      
      new_results$n_pos_adj = ifelse(new_results$total_sample_no < 52 & new_results$n_pos > 0,
                                     new_results$n_pos - 1, new_results$n_pos)
      new_results$percent_pos = (new_results$n_pos / new_results$total_sample_no) * 100
      new_results$percent_pos_adj = (new_results$n_pos_adj / new_results$total_sample_no) * 100
      new_results$percent_neg = (new_results$n_neg / new_results$total_sample_no) * 100
      new_results$rw_category = ifelse(new_results$total_sample_no < 10 & new_results$total_sample_no > 0 & new_results$n_pos <= 8, NA,
                                ifelse(new_results$percent_pos_adj > 15.4, "3",
                                ifelse(new_results$percent_pos_adj > 7.7 &
                                       new_results$percent_pos_adj <= 15.4, "2",
                                ifelse(new_results$percent_pos_adj <= 7.7, "1", ""))))
      
      row = data[which(data$establishment_id==establishment_ids[j], arr.ind=TRUE)[1],]
      new_results$establishment_size=row$establishment_size

      ##combine the new results with the all_results table
      fiftytwo_results_prevalence <- bind_rows(fiftytwo_results_prevalence, new_results)
    
    fiftytwo_start<-fiftytwo_start+days(7)
    fiftytwo_end<-fiftytwo_end+days(7)
    fiftytwo_interval<-interval(fiftytwo_start, fiftytwo_end)
      
    }
}

write.csv(fiftytwo_results_prevalence, "prevalencebasedresults_withNAcategory.csv")
```
